reason: Automatic 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification requires representations that jointly capture local waveform morphology, long-range temporal dynamics, and cross-lead dependencies, yet integrating these properties within a single efficient architecture remains challenging. This paper introduces a hybrid CNN-SSM-Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification.
